announcements.quote: All existing MOVR holders must bridge their tokens from Moonriver to Base before July 31, 2026 ... Once the chain winds down, funds left in on-chain protocols may become permanently inaccessible.

Moonriver enters Maintenance Mode at 00:00 UTC on August 1, 2026. After that time, all transactions are rejected and Moonscan stops serving network data. The network continues producing blocks during the operational wind-down.
Moonbeam & Moonriver enter Maintenance Mode at 00:00 UTC on August 1, 2026. After that time, all transactions will be rejected.
Bybit will terminate support for the Moonriver and Moonbeam networks ... MOVR and GLMR tokens will be migrated to the Base network.
Binance will discontinue the mainnet support of Moonriver (MOVR) and Moonbeam (GLMR) ... migrated ... to Base Network at a ratio of 1:1.
